# <span id="aanchor470"></span> Quality Download

FLOWCAL's SCADA request process provides a tool to download quality source data to a meter in the field via the SCADA system. This task may be requested by meter, list, or close group.

The following requirements must be met:

1.  The SCADA system must be able to read from the FC_SCADA_REQUEST table.
2.  Each meter must have a quality source assigned to it.
3.  Each meter must be configured for the data to be downloaded on the [Services &gt; Quality Download](../../Meters/Meter%20Editor/Services%20Tab.md#QualityDownload) tab in the Meter Editor.

<div class="procedure">

To access the SCADA Request Quality Download and edit an existing request:

1.  Go to **Tools** \> **SCADA** \> **Quality Download**.
2.  Select the appropriate name from the drop-down list, and go to **File** \> **Edit**.

To create a new request:

1.  Go to **File** \> **New**.

2.  Enter the new request name.

3.  Select the data type (meter, list or close group) and choose the desired meter, list, or close group from the drop-down list or tree view.

    The Force All Meters option allows users to force quality download requests to be processed for all meters for the selected request.

4.  Make any necessary changes to the request setup.

5.  Click **Save**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 508;height: 287;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Run Request">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Run a Quality Download Request</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Run Request">

<div class="procedure">

To run a quality download request:

1.  Select the name from the drop-down list.

2.  Click the **Run Now** button to make the request for the selected quality download.

3.  Click the **Messages** tab to see if the request was successful or if any errors occurred.

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 470;height: 236;" />

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Delete Request">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Delete a Quality Download Request</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Delete Request">

<div class="procedure">

To delete a quality download request:

1.  Select the name to be deleted from the drop-down list selection.

2.  Go to the **File** menu and click **Delete**.

    If the selected request is currently being edited by another user, the user will be presented with an error message letting the user know that the Request could not be deleted.

3.  When prompted, confirm the deletion. Click **Yes** to continue with the delete operation; click **No** to cancel the operation.

</div>

</div>
